name: unicorn-launch
description: UNICORN LAUNCH — инвестиционная платформа российского ОИП (монорепо)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w packages/ui --if-present && npm run build -w apps/core --if-present && npm run build -w apps/web-public --if-present && npm run build -w apps/admin --if-present && npm run build -w apps/lab --if-present && npm run build -w apps/investor --if-present && npm run build -w apps/expert --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
